title: Safe Catalog Manual Overrides with Actor Provenance
summary: Create GameManualOverride table holding explicit typed overrides (title, publisher, developer, franchise, releaseDate, productClass, imageUrl, isActive) with actor and reason provenance, preserving raw Game source data.
details: Collector syncs periodically overwrite Game fields. If an administrator manually corrects a title or product class directly on Game, subsequent syncs overwrite it unless separated.
